title: A code generator joins the showcase
summary:
A community code generator joined the showcase, while text error handling and ad matching got more precise.

A community-built Websim app was added to the project list and LLM Integrations showcase. It generates code from a description and chosen language, and includes Explainer and Reviewer modes.

Error logging now tolerates null entries in message arrays instead of throwing a second error and obscuring the original response.

Ad processing now skips the specific `v1_rblx_access` referrer rather than any referrer containing `roblox`. Affiliate selection was also adjusted, with Windsurf and Claude AI added and Character.AI weighted lower.

highlights.title: Community code generator
highlights.text: A Websim app in the project showcase generates code from a description and chosen language, with modes for explaining and reviewing code.
